full_judgment: A Judgment of reversal recorded by appellate Judge has been called in question by plaintiffs petitioners in invoking this Court's Civil Revisional Jurisdiction on laying a petition under section 115 of the Code of Civil Procedure whereupon Rule was issued calling upon opposite party Nos. 1 to 3 to show cause as to why Judgment and decree dated 29-11-1992 passed by learned Subordinate Judge and Artha Rin Adalat No. 1 Rangpur in Other Appeal No. 83 of 1991 setting aside those dated 28-5-1991 passed by Senior Assistant Judge Rangpur in Other Suit No. 104 of 1990 should not be set aside.
